faqs.question: How do I know this keyboard fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the Lenovo ThinkPad E580, E585 and L580, which share the same chassis (part 01YP680 / SN20P34095). If you're unsure of your exact model, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Does it come with the pointer/trackstick?
faqs.answer: Yes, this keyboard includes the pointer.

faqs.question: Is it backlit?
faqs.answer: No, this is the non-backlit version. We also stock a backlit version for this series.
